rules.rationale: Defines the per-character decoding summary as subtraction by five modulo the 26 lowercase character codes.
Defines the empty-sequence base case of the recursive decodeSpec mathematical summary.
Defines decodeSpec recursively by decoding the head character and then the remaining sequence.
Defines the per-character encoding summary as addition by five modulo the 26 lowercase character codes.
Defines the empty-sequence base case of the recursive encodeSpec mathematical summary.
Defines encodeSpec recursively by encoding the head character and then the remaining sequence.
Defines the named lowercase-code predicate as the inclusive integer range from 97 through 122.
Defines the empty-sequence base case of the recursive allLower domain predicate.
Defines allLower recursively as lowercase membership of the head conjoined with allLower on the tail.
